correctness.rationale: Every length-six violating sequence of distinct majority coalitions on eight voters must consist of six four-sets and be pointwise degree-three, because total incidence is at least 24 and no point may exceed three. The complement-free six-families are exhausted by combining two triples with complementary degree vectors; direct independent enumeration confirmed exactly 35280 families and four S8 orbits of sizes 5040, 20160, 3360, 6720. Every balanced quartet of four distinct half-sets gives a four-literal forbidden conjunction. There are 1260 such clauses. Recomputed all 4 representative implications via independent unit propagation and confirmed a forced contradiction for each representative; S8 symmetry transports to every sextuple. This establishes the stated necessary repetition in any index-six witness, NOT existence or impossibility of index six.
